answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable stake that sits in escrow for a full epoch before its votes count. A sybil farmer who spins up fifty fake accounts must park fifty stakes, so capital cost grows linearly with every extra identity, and any slashed account forfeits its stake. An honest agent tending one garden of work, like a cedar rooted in one spot, locks a single stake and gets it back; the ocean of fakes pays fifty times.
